summary: Wednesday's session was defined by a sharp flight into long Treasuries, with TLT up roughly 4% over two weeks pulling bond sentiment into greed while real yields fell to 2.64%. Equities split along defensive lines as staples outran a weak Nasdaq, and gold's safe-haven bid broke down, sliding further even as the dollar stayed soft.
tweet: Treasuries rallied hard and staples beat tech, but gold's safe-haven bid broke down despite falling real yields and a soft dollar.
